name: Nahara Natsu
source: An operator at the 7th branch of W.L.O and a waitress who works at a cafe called "Pothos". She has a cool personality and rarely shows her emotions on her face. Natsu's main mission is to teach Yuuki, as she is supposed to be in charge of his studies.
